Daily Devotional

December 16

24 For as the lightning, that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven, shineth unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day. (Luke 17:24 KJV)

This verse and that of Matthew (Matthew 24:27) make it very clear that when Jesus comes again, the whole world will know it. Some religions have taught that Jesus has already returned secretly, but these verses refute that, and we will all know when His Second Coming takes place. Jesus was making it clear that believers need not chase after reports that Jesus has returned to earth, as we will all be able to observe His coming, and we are not to be deceived into thinking otherwise. We should not be obsessed with when He is coming, but as it is written, we need to be ready at all times for His return (1 Peter 4:7). If you walk after the Spirit and not the flesh (Romans 8:4), then you will be ready for His return no matter when it is. Live your life for Jesus, praying always to the Father (Luke 21:36), and you will be ready when Jesus does return. Don’t be a Sunday only Christian, as He may not come back on a Sunday!

Jesus also told us that no one knows the exact date or time of His Second Coming, but the Father alone (Matthew 24:36), and we should not believe predictions of man or Angels about the timing of this event. There has been much speculation as to whether Jesus will come in what is called the Rapture of the Church, or if His Second Coming will be at the judgment of the earth by God. According to the book of Revelation that John wrote, Jesus will first gather His church (Revelation 14:14-16) just before the wrath of God is poured out (Revelation 16). If you want a complete review of the end times, visit our web site page “New Revelations” and it shows the sequence of events during the end times. Praise God for the Holy Spirit to give us such revelations.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
